task: In Production, set up (but do not start) an experiment named "live_chat_copy test" on the multivariate flag "live_chat_copy". Hypothesis: "Pay securely" increases add to cart versus "Checkout". The primary metric "add_to_cart" should increase, and "support_ticket_opened" is a guardrail that should not increase. Split users evenly between the control and the variation.
finalText: FAILED: this Flagsmith instance (v2.295.2) has no experiments API and the CLI has no experiment command, so I could not create the experiment in Production. Every experiment-related path I tried returned the UI's HTML page on GET and 405 on POST, and `flagsmith --help` lists no experiment command. The only way to approximate it would be editing the live `live_chat_copy` variant weights, which would start serving the variant to users, so I changed nothing.
